subject: Media Literacy
title: Social Media Propaganda Bots
description: Learn Social Media Propaganda Bots in one minute.

hook.text: During the 2016 U.S. election, Russian bots generated over 10 million tweets to influence voters.

buildup.text: Propaganda bots are automated accounts that amplify messages, create fake trends, and harass opponents.

discovery.text: Studies estimate that up to 15% of Twitter accounts were bots before the platform's ownership changed.

twist.text: Bots don't need to convince you directly. They create the illusion that 'everyone' believes something.

climax.text: When you see a trending topic, you can't tell if it reflects real opinion or a bot army's algorithm.

punchline.text: Trending doesn't mean popular. Sometimes it means automated.

quiz.question: What is the primary purpose of propaganda bots?
options: To create the illusion of widespread support for a position
